messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: automatic alert triggered for tenant: AcmeCorp in dedicated pool eu-west1. Metric: downstream quality regression (LLM exact-match dropped ~18% vs baseline) — severity: P2. Linked eval: https://evals.redwood/internal/tenant/ACME/12345
maya: oncall here, reading the alert. Acme is on a dedicated pool with pinned model 'longform-v2' + q8_2 quant profile, correct?
sanjay: yup. We pushed a quantization profile update PR last night that rolled to a subset of dedicated pools for testing. Looks like Acme got the variant due to their canary routing rule.
elena: I see increased hallucination rates in the eval diff. Quantization bias on some rare tokens — likely precision loss in q8_2 for long-context.
brynn: Customer success just flagged an enterprise complaint — their backend QA noticed the answers are shorter and sometimes missing citations. They want an ETA.
maya: tagging @customer-success — please tell them we're investigating and will provide mitigation shortly. @sanjay @elena can we revert them to previous profile?
sanjay: We can roll back their quant profile via the control plane: `redwood rollout profile revert --tenant acme-corp --model longform-v2 --from q8_2 --to q8_1 --reason "quality regression"` — minimal downtime, should flip within 30s for active routes.
elena: q8_1 is the previous profile with slightly larger tokens but known quality. Also option: route Acme traffic to a float16 variant (`longform-v2-fp16`) if we want zero quant risk, but that will increase cost and may affect capacity.
maya: prefer revert profile first. If that fails, failover to fp16. Sanjay, can you run the revert and watch evaluation logs? I'll coordinate comms.
sanjay: executing now. Running in dry-run then apply.
```bash
# dry-run
redwood rollout profile revert --tenant acme-corp --model longform-v2 --from q8_2 --to q8_1 --dry-run
# apply
redwood rollout profile revert --tenant acme-corp --model longform-v2 --from q8_2 --to q8_1
```
ops-bot: Revert job queued: job-id=rb-2026-09-02-77, estimated apply windows: immediate.
ryan: I'll shadow metrics; pushing a focused eval on production traffic sample (20k tokens) to validate.
elena: also capture KV-cache mismatch logs — sometimes quant changes change tokenization alignment. Add this query: `select * from inference_logs where tenant='acme-corp' and model='longform-v2' and reason='quality' limit 100`
brynn: passing ETA to customer: "We're rolling back a model profile to restore your previous quality. Expect improved outputs within a minute; we'll confirm when verified." They asked for a 15-min follow-up.
maya: revert applied (job rb-2026-09-02-77 done). Observability note: route config replaced, active nodes reported new profile q8_1.
ops-bot: Canary check results: 1) latency: +3ms, 2) token cost: +6%, 3) quality: exact-match delta +16% (good).
ryan: verifying on sampled production traffic — immediate improvement on 80% of samples. I'm seeing hallucination count fall back to baseline.
elena: quick post-change regression test shows previous failing prompt cases resolved. Need to run full eval sweep but looks positive.
sanjay: no errors in canary. Rolling full tenant routing back to q8_1 completed.
maya: great. Next steps: 1) Notify customer success to send a short email update, 2) schedule root-cause analysis with ML infra and model team, 3) block aggressive rollout of q8_2 to dedicated pools until we have a signed-off canary plan.
brynn: I'll email Acme: "We reverted a recent inference profile change that caused reduced answer quality. Your service is back to expected behavior. We will follow up with a detailed RCA and next steps by EOD"
ryan: Action items assigned: @elena run extended evals (owner: elena, ETA: 4h), @sanjay add a safety flag to routing so future profile changes to dedicated tenants require explicit opt-in (owner: sanjay, ETA: 24h), @maya draft postmortem (owner: maya, ETA: EOD).
elena: also recommend adding a per-tenant quality smoke test before applying quant profile changes: sample 5k tokens and check exact-match and hallucination thresholds. Will propose a test harness.
maya: on-call handoff: I'll be handing to @sanjay in 30m; Sanjay will be primary for follow-ups. Any other immediate needs?
sanjay: I'll watch infra metrics and ensure q8_2 rollout remains paused. I'll also create an incident tag for Acme so we can track any residual complaints.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity downgraded to P3 (no customer downtime, quality regression mitigated), timeline recorded, playbooks attached: https://playbooks.redwood/internal/quant-regression
maya: thanks team. Brynn, please keep customer updated and escalate to account exec if they request credits or contract remedies.
brynn: noted. cc'ing acct-exec.
maya: closing thread — will append postmortem link when available. Thanks for quick turn. :thumbsup:
